results.question: what rank are we?
what rank is a county magistrate?
what is the doctrine of three steps
results.reply:
Doctrine of Three Steps (Three Steps; Measure of Standing; peer standing): the rules of the Measure of Standing for what is appropriate between samurai of different ranks, including when one samurai is of peer standing with another.
It governs bounties, duels and arrests.
[Doctrine of Three Steps](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/doctrine-of-three-steps)

results.question: how far does a blood feud reach?
results.reply:
It extends to every descendant of each named person's paternal great-grandfather on both sides.
Any of them may lawfully kill any on the other side.
[Blood feud](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/blood-feuds) has the full details.

results.question: what was the family reckoning?
what does righteous sting mean?
results.reply:
Righteous Sting is a Wasp campaign custom advantage from the Family Reckoning.
Your relative acted honorably at the teahouse.
Your Rank counts higher, and the party's too.
Related: [Custom advantages and disadvantages](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/custom-advantages-and-disadvantages)

results.question: what does the peasantborn disadvantage do
results.reply:
Peasantborn (peasantborn lineage disadvantage) means you are the child of a peasant [Tsuruchi](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi) raised to samurai.
You are never of peer standing with samurai-born.

results.question: how much of a bounty do we keep?
results.reply:
Traditionally the collector keeps half.
Their superior takes a tenth.
The rest goes to the daimyo's treasury.
